text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off,
while out shopping with Mejiro Palmer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a LANE message from Dober.
I wonder what's up...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Umm... 'It's the day of my TV appearance, but I'm so nervous I don't feel like I can speak properly.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Dober's recording was today!
You could've asked for help sooner!
She really is such a hard worker~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer!
I'm going to step out for a second—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, again? Dober seems pretty panicked...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, never mind, is it from Bright this time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...'Doze off on the train,
and you find yourself at an unfamiliar station'...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A-At a time like this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, what should I do?
Leaving Bright on her own is a bit
precarious, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but
I can't just leave Dober alone either...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Umm... umm-mmm?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer is pacing back and forth in an unusually flustered state. It might be best to step in and make the decision for her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Dober...
But what about Bright, then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Oh right, Ardan's schedule
should be wide open today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
âAh, hello, Ardan-san?
It's about Bright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I rushed over to the TV studio
where Mejiro Dober was waiting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew, looks like we made it in time for the recording.
Uhm, where's Dober—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
P-Palmer!
I'm sorry, I never thought you'd come...
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd be fine on my own, but when the moment actually came, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, totally, totally!
To be honest, I get pretty nervous too~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Palmer too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I do, I do! Like, will I be able to talk properly, or am I gonna say something weird...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, things always work out in the end! The interviewers are pros, and it's not live anyway~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: “I see... Yeah, you're right. If I just take it calmly...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you...
I feel like... I can actually do this...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see!
...Fufu, what a relief!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Red light! Haha... It's so frustrating getting caught at one at a time like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, red light again?
Today is just not my day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: R-Red again!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah... at this rate, we might not make it in time, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'm gonna hit the Umamusume lanes for a bit!
Sorry, Trainer! Thanks for hanging out with me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Bright...
Wait, but then what about Dober—
choice_data_list: I wonder if I could ask Ryan to do it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Ahaha, totally slipped my mind.
Besides, Dober's more warmed up to Ryan anyway,
so that might be good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Umm, Ryan's LANE is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I hurried over to the station
where Mejiro Bright was waiting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Palmer~!
You actually came~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you're safe!
You really are as carefree as ever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but
I'm just glad it wasn't as far as that other time!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "That time," you say~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Remember how you ended up going all the way to Aomori back then?
You called Ardan-san... and then it took all of us hours to go pick you up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...
Fufu, that really did happen, didn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But I will not wander that far anymore.
After all, I have grown up, too~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...That feels a little lonely in its own way, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it kind of turned into a group trip,
and that was pretty fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, our transfer is two stops from now.
Let's rest a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, there's a huge crowd.
I wonder what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Station PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
“—Attention, passengers.
Due to an onboard incident,
the train's arrival is currently delayed.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa.
Looks like she's pretty worked up, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? I could call a car, but...
At this distance, I think I can run the rest of the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll be right back.
Trainer, thanks for coming
all this way with me!
